centroid_rule: manual symbol class and y-window choice; mean of pixels darker than 125 in 15x15 window, including possible line contribution
time_values: nominal times reported in methods, not fitted from x coordinates
initial_values: printed means; not exact latent initial concentrations
SEM: figure caption reports SEM n=3; no pointwise SEM inferred from visible pixel widths
replication: reported measurement triplicates; independent biological lots not established
water_addition: 3 mL per 0.2 g flour before reaction stop
analytical_basis: mg maltose per g dry flour
parameter_bounds: working numerical limits not material constants
plot: own plotted reconstruction and model fits; no original figure redistributed
